statement: ∀ (p f n m : ℕ), p.Prime → n ≤ m → (p^f)^n * p^(f*(m-n)) = (p^f)^m

plain_statement.en: New route · 29-adic generation and counterfamilies · JA-0018 · Count the exact index between powers of the uniformizer

brief.zh: 每个连续商有 pᶠ 个元素，乘指数。代入 f=1、n=1、m=4 得三个剩余域方向。
brief.en: Each successive quotient has pᶠ elements. Substitute f=1, n=1 and m=4 for the three residue layers.
